title: Project Serpo book built on Puthoff's spacetime metric engineering

tellings.quote: and one thing that stood out to me was that the whole project Serpo book completely integrates Halputo off spaceimetric engineering.

plain: The Project Serpo book, which tells of a supposed exchange in which Americans travelled to an alien planet, is said to be built entirely on the physics of Hal Puthoff, a physicist who has worked on government studies of the unexplained. Deep Prasad, a researcher, tells Michels what struck him on reading it: "the whole project Serpo book completely integrates" Puthoff's "spacetime metric engineering", the idea of reshaping space and time itself to drive a craft. To Prasad, that link suggests the story draws on serious physics.
